arabic_text: أَوْ أَمَدَّهُ بِعِتَاد، أَوْ شَحَذَهُ عَلَى جِهَاد، أَوْ أَتْبَعَهُ فِي وَجْهِهِ دَعْوَةً، أَوْ رَعَى لَهُ مِنْ وَرَآئِهِ حُرْمَةً.
transliteration: aw amaddahu biʿitād, aw shahadah ʿalā jihād aw atbaʿahu fi wajhihi daʿwatan aw raʿa lahu min warāʾihi ḥurmatan
english_text: assist him with equipment, hone him for the struggle, send along with him a supplication for his purpose, or guard his honour in his absence,

arabic_text: فَأْجِرْ لَهُ مِثْلَ أَجْرِهِ وَزْناً بِوَزْن وَمِثْلاً بِمِثْل وَعَوِّضْهُ مِنْ فِعْلِهِ عِوَضاً حَاضِراً يَتَعَجَّلُ بِهِ نَفْعَ مَا قَدَّمَ، وَسُرُورَ مَا أَتَى به، إلَى أَنْ يَنْتَهِيَ بِهِ الْوَقْتُ
transliteration: fa'jir lahu mithla ajrihi waznan biwazn wa mithlan bimithl wa ʿawwidh-hu min fiʿlih ʿiwadan ḥāḍiran yataʿajjaluhu nafʿa mā qaddama wa surūra mā atā bih, ilā an yantahiyah bih al-waqtu
english_text: reward him with the like of his reward measure for measure, like for like, and recompense him for his act with an immediate compensation through which he will hasten to the profit of what he has sent forth and the joy of what he has given, till the present moment takes him

arabic_text: إلَى مَاأَجْرَيْتَ لَـهُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، وَأَعْدَدْتَ لَهُ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ.
transliteration: ʾilā mā ʾajrayta lahū min faḍlika wa aʿdadta lahu min karamatika
english_text: to the bounty Thou hast granted to him and the generosity Thou hast prepared for him!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا مُسْلِم أَهَمَّهُ أَمْرُ الإِسْلاَمِ وَأَحْزَنَهُ تَحَزُّبُ أَهْلِ ألشِّرْكِ عَلَيْهِمْ فَنَوَى غَزْواً أَوْ هَمَّ بِجهَـاد فَقَعَدَ بِـهِ ضَعْفٌ أَوْ أَبطَأَتْ بِهِ فَاقَةٌ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa-ayyumā muslimin ahammahu amr al-islām wa'ahzanahu tahazzubu ahli ash-shirki 'alayhim fanawā ghazwan aw hamm bi-jihād faqaʿada bihi ḍaʿfun aw abṭʾat bihi fāqah
english_text: O God, and if the affair of Islam should worry a Muslim and the alliance of the idolaters' against Islam should grieve him, so that he has the intention to go to war and is about to enter the struggle, but frailty keeps him seated, neediness keeps him waiting,

arabic_text: أَوْ أَخَّرَهُ عَنْهُ حَادِثٌ، أَوْ عَرَضَ لَهُ دُونَ إرَادَتِهِ مَانِعٌ، فَاكْتُبِ اسْمَـهُ فِي الْعَابِدِينَ وَأوْجبْ لَهُ ثَوَابَ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ
transliteration: aw akhkhara-hu ʿanhu hadithun aw ʿarada lahu dūna irādatihi māniʿun fa ktub isma-hu fil ʿabidin wa ʾawjab lahu thawāba al-mujāhidīn
english_text: a mishap delays him, or an obstruction prevents him from his wish, write his name among the worshipers, make incumbent for him the reward of the strugglers,

transliteration: wajʿalhu fī niẓāmi al-shuhadāʾi wa al-ṣāliḥīn
english_text: and place him among the ranks of the martyrs and the righteous!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ وَآلِ مُحَمَّد صَلاَةً عَالِيَةً عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ مُشْرِفَةً فَوْقَ التَّحِيَّاتِ، صَلاَةً لاَ يَنْتَهِي أَمَدُهَا
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad ʿabdika wa rasūlika wa āli muḥammad ṣalātan ʿāliyatun ʿalā al-ṣalawāt mushrifatan fawqa t-tahiyyatِ ṣalātan lā yantahī amaduhā.
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad, Thy slave and Thy messenger, and the Household of Muhammad, with a blessing high above all other blessings, towering beyond all other salutations, a blessing whose end is never reached

arabic_text: وَلا يَنْقَطِعُ عَدَدُهَا كَأَتَمِّ مَـا مَضَى مِنْ صَلَوَاتِكَ عَلَى أَحَد مِنْ أَوْلِيـائِكَ،
transliteration: walā yanqaṭiʿu ʿadaduhā ka'atammi maa madaa min ṣalaawaatika ʿalā ʾaḥad min awliyāʾika
english_text: and whose number is never cut off, like the most perfect of Thy blessings that has passed to any one of Thy friends!

arabic_text: إنَّـكَ الْمَنَّانُ الْحَمِيدُ الْمُبْدِئُ الْمُعِيدُ الفَعَّالُ لِمَا تُرِيْدُ.
transliteration: ʾinnaka almannānu alḥamīd al-mubdi'u al-mu'īd al-faʿālu limā turīd
english_text: Thou art All-kind, Praiseworthy, the Originator who takes back again, Accomplisher of what Thou desirest.
